description: Spawns an agent that replaces a slot's grey-X placeholder with a real spritesheet via the manifest-v2 asset pipeline (no code change, no procedural fallback).

fields.description: An existing slot key in data/slots.json. Its category fixes the frame size.
fields.label: Slot key

fields.description: Source sheet. It is copied to data/sprites/imported/<slot>.png (committed content, D-31).
fields.label: Spritesheet path (.png)

fields.description: False = idle-only slot (import_idle_sheet writes one row). True = one manifest row per animation, row 0 always idle (schema-forced).
fields.label: Multi-animation sheet

title: Replace a Visual
